title: Ella O'Connor, Women & Toddlers Park Pram - Vintage 1940s Sepia Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription: Our upstairs neighbor Ella O'Connor and Dennie, Penny and me. 126 N
description: Two cheerful women sit together on the ground outdoors in a sunny park alongside two young children, Dennie and Penny. In the background, a path with an iron railing and a vintage baby carriage (pram) are visible against trees. The image captures friendly postwar neighborhood community life, maternal camaraderie, and casual outdoor leisure in mid-1940s America.
